name: Moonroot Tide
a: Thick green tree roots burst up from the bottom centre and twist upward, lifting a glowing pale blue full moon wrapped in a ring of sea water at the top.
b: A splash ring of blue sea water mixed with green leaves bursting outward
snd: roots creaking up through earth, then a bright splash of water

name: Horn Tide
a: A ball of blue sea water held between two curved beetle horns of yellow lightning, arcs jumping across it, turning in place.
b: An electric water burst: a blue splash thrown outward with forks of yellow lightning
snd: a rushing wave of water crackling with electricity, then a wet electric burst

name: Blizzard Spout
a: A twisting waterspout of white snow and pale blue ice shards spinning up from the bottom centre to the top of the frame.
b: A burst of snow puffs and ice shards flung outward by curling wind
snd: a howling icy whirlwind spinning up, with crackling ice

name: Summit Beam
a: A shaft of golden-white sunlight breaks down from the top of the frame onto a small grey mountain peak at the bottom centre, and the peak glows and cracks with light.
b: A burst of golden light with flying pale stone chips
snd: a bright rising shimmer then a heavy crack of stone

name: Hollow Mountain
a: Dark purple-black rock slabs with glowing violet cracks rise at the left and right edges of the frame and slam together in the centre like a cave mouth closing.
b: An implosion of violet light with dark rock shards and purple dust thrown outward
snd: two huge stone slabs grinding and slamming shut with a deep hollow boom

name: Glacier Fist
a: A giant fist of grey rock coated in blue ice punches straight down from the top of the frame to the bottom centre, with frost trailing behind it.
b: A ring of ice spikes and rock chunks bursting from an impact, with frosty mist
snd: a heavy icy punch landing, a deep thud with cracking ice

name: Frozen Tide
a: Two waves of blue sea water curl up from the left and right edges of the frame towards the centre and freeze solid mid-curl into a cage of ice, white frost spreading over them.
b: A frozen wave shatters into ice shards and cold water spray
snd: a wave rushing in and freezing with a sharp crackle, then ice shattering

name: Boulder Surf
a: A big grey boulder riding inside a rolling ball of blue wave water with white foam, turning in place.
b: A splash of blue water and grey stone chunks thrown outward
snd: a rolling wave carrying a heavy rock, then a crashing stony splash

name: Fire Whirl
a: A whirling tornado of orange flame with feathers of fire spiralling up from the bottom centre to the top of the frame.
b: A burst of burning feathers and embers scattering on the wind
snd: a roaring whirl of fire spinning up, with a bird-like screech in the flames

name: Acorn Squall
a: A glossy brown acorn with one green leaf, spinning in a small swirl of pale wind.
b: A small burst of green leaves, wind streaks and bits of acorn shell
snd: three quick woody knocks in a row with gusts of wind and rustling leaves

name: Dawn Pyre
a: A phoenix wing of white-gold light unfolds upward from a cracked stone at the bottom centre, its feathers of light fanning out to the top of the frame.
b: A sunrise burst: golden rays and glowing feathers thrown outward
snd: a warm rising whoosh of flame and a bright bird cry, glowing and hopeful

name: Ash Mountain
a: A chunk of black volcanic rock seen falling straight down: the rock at the bottom centre of the frame, with violet flames and ash streaming straight up behind it to the top of the frame, flickering.
b: An impact of black ash cloud with violet embers and rock shards
snd: a burning rock falling with a low roar, then a heavy ashy impact

name: Spore Gale
a: A spinning cloud of glowing yellow-green mushroom spores carried in a swirl of wind, with small mushroom caps tumbling in it, turning in place.
b: A puff of yellow-green spores bursting outward with small mushrooms popping
snd: a soft whooshing gust full of fine dust, then a muffled puffing burst

name: Antler Blaze
a: Two great stag antlers made of white-gold fire grow in from the left and right edges of the frame and lock together in the centre.
b: A burst of white-gold fire with glowing sparks
snd: two blazing antlers clashing together with a crackling fiery clack

name: Frozen Strings
a: A wooden puppet cross-bar at the top of the frame drops thin strings of pale blue ice straight down; they pull tight and frost creeps down them to one point at the bottom centre.
b: The strings snap: a burst of ice needles and dark violet wisps
snd: thin icy strings pulling taut with a creak, then snapping in a tinkling crack

name: Spore Stampede
a: A horseshoe of bright green light spinning in place, trailing spores and small leaves.
b: A hoofprint-shaped burst of green spores and wind
snd: galloping hooves rushing past, then a soft thump and puff of dust

name: Old Growth
a: A great oak tree grows in seconds from a seed at the bottom centre: trunk, branches, then a full green crown, with glowing mushrooms on the trunk, until it fills the frame.
b: A tree crown bursts into a shower of green leaves and glowing spores
snd: wood creaking and stretching as a tree grows fast, then a great rustle of leaves

name: Three-Eyed Volt
a: Three glowing white eyes open in a triangle at the top of the frame, and each fires a straight beam of yellow-white lightning down to one point at the bottom centre.
b: A white-gold electric burst with small feather-shaped sparks
snd: three sharp electric zaps in quick succession with a raven caw

name: Murder of Sparks
a: A small raven made of black-violet shadow with wings of crackling violet lightning, seen from the front, flapping in place.
b: A burst of black feathers and violet lightning
snd: ravens cawing and wings flapping, with three crackling electric hits

name: Stone Broadside
a: A round grey stone cannonball spinning in place, with a swirl of wind round it and a wisp of white smoke.
b: An impact puff of dust, stone chips and wind streaks
snd: three cannon shots booming one after another with whistling stone

name: Frostcap Bite
a: Wolf jaws made of blue ice with small frosted mushrooms growing along the teeth: an upper and a lower row of fangs starting at the top and bottom edges of the frame and snapping shut together in the centre. Only the fangs, no head.
b: A burst of ice shards, snow and pale blue mushroom spores
snd: a wolf snarl and icy jaws snapping shut with a crunch of ice

name: Marionette Mountain
a: A huge grey boulder hangs on dark violet puppet strings from the top of the frame; the strings are cut and the boulder drops to the bottom centre.
b: A burst of dust and rock with snapped violet strings whipping outward
snd: strings snapping with a twang, then a boulder crashing down

name: Cinder Crown
a: A black iron crown seen falling straight down: the crown at the bottom centre of the frame, burning, with violet and orange flames streaming straight up behind it to the top of the frame.
b: A burst of violet and orange fire with black feathers and cinders
snd: a burning metal crown falling with a fiery whoosh and a ringing clang

name: Tidepool Bloom
a: A tide pool seen from above at a slant, as a wide ellipse: clear blue water ringed with glowing mushrooms and sea anemones, its ripples slowly turning.
b: A fountain of water, petals and glowing spores bursting straight up from the bottom centre to the top of the frame
snd: gentle bubbling water swelling into a splashing fountain with a soft chime

name: Seraph Current
a: Six wings made of deep blue water edged with crackling yellow lightning unfold from the edges of the frame and fold shut over the centre.
b: A burst of deep-sea blue water and lightning with glowing cyan specks
snd: great wet wings sweeping shut underwater with an electric surge

name: Aurora Howl
a: Ribbons of aurora light in green, pink and pale blue rise from the bottom centre and wave upward to the top of the frame like curtains, with drifting snowflakes.
b: A burst of aurora-coloured light with snow crystals
snd: a long wolf howl with a shimmering, glassy rising tone

name: Black Ice
a: A patch of black ice seen from above at a slant, as a wide ellipse: glossy, with violet reflections and bright violet cracks slowly spreading and turning across it.
b: Black ice spikes with bright violet edges stab straight up from the bottom centre to the top of the frame, then crumble
snd: ice creaking and cracking underfoot, then sharp spikes stabbing up with a dark hiss

name: Lightning Rod
a: A tall iron rod stands on a stone at the bottom centre; a thick yellow-white lightning bolt slams down the frame into it from the top edge and the stone glows hot.
b: A burst of electric arcs along the ground with hot stone chips
snd: a huge lightning strike hitting metal with a ringing electric crack

name: Avalanche Sail
a: A mass of snow, ice and boulders seen falling straight down: the mass at the bottom centre of the frame, with a torn white sail and snow spray streaming straight up behind it to the top of the frame.
b: An avalanche impact: a wide burst of snow cloud with rocks
snd: an avalanche rumbling down fast and crashing with a deep whump

name: Ice Age
a: A ring of spiral ammonite fossils made of blue ice starts at the edges of the frame and spirals inward, closing to the centre, with frost spreading behind it.
b: A burst of ice shards and fossil shell fragments with frost mist
snd: deep ancient ice groaning and closing in, then a brittle shatter

name: Iceberg Crash
a: An iceberg, white on top and deep blue beneath, drops from the top of the frame into a line of sea water at the bottom centre.
b: A great splash of sea water with chunks of ice
snd: a massive block of ice plunging into the sea with a huge splash

name: Sandstone Cyclone
a: A cyclone of tan sand and small fossil shells spinning up from the bottom centre to the top of the frame, with hot orange glints in it.
b: A burst of sand cloud and fossil fragments thrown out in a ring
snd: a gritty sandstorm whirling up with rattling stones

name: Heartwood Light
a: A white stag's antlers grow upward from the bottom centre like a tree of light, budding green leaves and white blossoms at their tips, up to the top of the frame.
b: A burst of white blossoms and golden light
snd: a gentle rising chime with soft rustling leaves and a warm glow

name: Eclipse Oak
a: A black tree hangs upside down from the top of the frame, its crown a dark disc with a thin ring of white light round it like a solar eclipse; a beam of pale light drops from it to the bottom centre.
b: A ring of white light with dark violet leaves bursting outward
snd: an eerie low hum swelling, then a hollow ringing strike

name: Thunder Forge
a: A giant mechanical piston of brass and stone hammers straight down from the top of the frame to the bottom centre, with lightning arcing round it.
b: A burst of electric arcs, hot rivets and stone chips with a shock ring
snd: a huge machine piston slamming down with a metallic boom and electric crackle
